expected: HTTP failures, truncated SSE, disconnects and queue/cancel faults cannot falsely succeed or repeat completed side effects.
limitations: OMP retries cannot be disabled on openai-completions: HTTP 500 produced 12 identical requests (6 transport x 2 provider attempts).
observed: HTTP 400/401/404/500, dropped connections, malformed SSE, in-band errors, SIGINT and --max-time stalls all end as errors with no false completion, and a resumed session does not repeat a completed side effect. The three expected failures persist on this tuple: when the model's turn ends inside a tool call, stock Strata v0.1.30's frontend still closes the partial arguments and reports finish_reason tool_calls (the MockEngine reproducer emits the closing fragment `"}` with 15 content bytes), and stock OMP 18.4.6 still executes the tool with truncated arguments (a partial file write happens; exit 0). finish_reason length is handled safely (no execution). HTTP 500 still produced 12 identical requests with retry.enabled=false.
reason: Stock Strata v0.1.30 finalizes a tool call cut off by the end of the turn and stock OMP 18.4.6 executes its truncated arguments; fixes are proposed upstream (Strata#231, can1357/oh-my-pi#13868), neither released.
